result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Answer A says the setup is mostly sound, names what already works, and makes a few small, reversible changes. Each change comes with a reason and the values to revert it. Answer B rewrites much of the stylesheet: it enlarges the body text and headings, adds a drop cap and gray colors, recommends replacing Georgia, and doesn't explain the body size or line-height changes. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B says the existing setup is sound, names what already works and keeps nearly every value as it was, limiting its edits to heading weight and tracking, the blockquote style and text-wrap. Each change comes with a reason, though making the blockquote upright is debatable. A rewrites much of the stylesheet: it enlarges the body and headings, adds a decorative drop cap, changes colors and recommends swapping the typeface, which is the kind of response the rubric penalizes.
